rules.name: nan-loss
rules.text: Stop when the loss is NaN on 3 reports in a row.

rules.name: diverging
rules.text: Stop when the loss is more than 1 above the parent's at the same step, 3 reports running.

rules.name: behind-parent
rules.text: Ask when val loss is 0.5 above the parent's at the same step on 2 evals in a row.

rules.name: eval-collapse
rules.text: Ask when the eval score falls below 0.1.
